info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Model By Param1-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows users to access specific business risk models based on a provided parameter. It serves as a crucial resource for financial institutions and risk managers seeking to assess and analyze potential business risks. By targeting unique identifiers, users can efficiently retrieve relevant models that help in decision-making and risk assessment processes. Typical consumers of this API include analysts, risk managers, and developers integrating risk models into their applications.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific business risk model by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific business risk model identified by its unique ID. Use this to gather insights and data necessary for analysis and reporting.
